title: Settings — account + appearance shells
description: Two adapter-driven settings shells behind one slug — the consumer injects an adapter and the slice owns no data. account: a profile / preferences / notifications / danger-zone shell (<SettingsShell />) over an ASYNC load+save SettingsAdapter, collapsing to a Select on mobile, with a createMemoryAdapter() for demos. appearance: a style / mode / accent / wallpaper / reduce-transparency / display shell (<AppearancePanel />) over a SYNC per-setting AppearanceAdapter, plus the generic SettingsSection / SettingsRow / Segmented / AccentSwatches primitives you compose your own panels from. Install one surface with `npx rr add settings account|appearance`, or both with `npx rr add settings`.

items.title: Account
